title: Video Project Scene Plan Output
description: Matches the ScenePlanSkillOutput type in server/services/videoProjectScenePlanner.ts — the section-05 adapter parses the skill output against this shape. Template SELECTION + parameter BINDING only: NO property name in this file may match /prompt|imagePrompt|videoPrompt|negativePrompt/i.

sceneId.description: An existing plannable scene id from the input's plannableScenes, or a genuinely new id to append.

templateId.description: Must key into the input's availableTemplates list exactly.

templateParams.description: Must satisfy the chosen template's own paramsJsonSchema exactly. Bind real data only — never invent a value.

rationale.description: Why this template fits this beat. Free-form prose is allowed here only.

onScreenStatements.description: Concrete claim/price/metric strings this scene's templateParams put on screen, for the claim-compliance join. Empty array when nothing claim-like applies.

summary.description: Short free-form summary of the plan.
